name: 열지기 발레르
quote: 문은 닫혔다. 너의 길은 여기서 끝이다.
horns: 머리 위로 솟은 두 개의 빛나는 뿔
wings: 등 뒤에 떠 있는 빛의 고리 형태의 날개
outfit: 화려한 금색 장식이 박힌 백색 의복
weapon: 거대한 태양의 문장이 새겨진 황금 창
silhouette: 머리 위의 빛나는 뿔, 뒤로 길게 뻗은 불꽃 꼬리, 등 뒤의 거대한 빛의 고리, 거대한 창의 수직 실루엣, 흐르는 듯한 망토
signature_motion: 창을 바닥에 찍으며 주변으로 충격파를 방출함
visual_en: A 2-head tall divine beast facing right. The character features brilliant white fur and a flowing platinum mane. On its head, two glowing golden horns protrude upwards. Behind the back, a large, radiant golden ring-shaped wing floats, emitting bright light particles. A long tail with a flame-like split tip sweeps behind. The beast holds a massive golden spear engraved with a sun crest. It wears luxurious gold-plated armor pieces over its white body, accented by small crimson gems. A flowing white cape with gold edges drapes from its shoulders, and small golden rings adorn its ankles. The entire silhouette is defined by high-contrast gold and white against the dark dungeon.
pose_en: Standing tall and imposing, pointing the spear towards the ground.
vfx_en: Explosive bursts of bright golden solar particles.
motion_en: Stomping the ground to trigger a massive solar shockwave.
lore: 보스 공통 패턴만 있다(돌진·탄막·예고 장판·졸개 소환). 생김새와 성격은 자유.

anim_notes.skill: firing a barrage of glowing bullets outward
anim_notes.ultimate: slamming a glowing warning circle onto the ground and summoning minions
anim_notes.vfx: a glowing red warning circle on the ground
